2020-08-02/1002.title: The handoff
2020-08-02/1002.html:
The handoff

After the Nefarian kill this night, Artimis told the raid that Divinestorm would become Guild Master, thanking everyone for the trust and the fun. The guild-system message from the same minute records the handoff — the end of the founder's tenure, mid-raid.

2020-08-23/1005.title: C'Thun, five days in
2020-08-23/1005.html:
C'Thun, five days in

The doubters answered: less than two weeks earlier, officers of the old Ninjas had privately questioned whether the merged guild had "the quality to clear AQ." Dusk killed C'Thun five days after its first raid as a guild.

2020-09-17/1005.title: The pull that broke September
2020-09-17/1005.html:
The pull that broke September

An unannounced pull at the Ahn'Qiraj entrance caught the raid unbuffed and unready; the world buffs evaporated in seconds. The guild's top hunter left the raid on the spot, the rogues nearly followed, and the officer chat spent the next three days arguing about respect, world buffs and what kind of guild this was supposed to be. Within a week, the tank who made the pull and one of the officers had both left the guild.

2020-12-13/1006.title: Twelve wipes on the Horsemen
2020-12-13/1006.html:
Twelve wipes on the Horsemen

The joint raid hit the Four Horsemen wall: twelve wipes in one evening while the tank rotation was drilled. Several long-serving raiders watched from the bench, and the frustration from this night fed directly into the week that ended the guild.

2020-12-14/1006.title: Four Horsemen fall — first pull of the night
2020-12-14/1006.html:
Four Horsemen fall — first pull of the night

After Sunday's twelve wipes, the encounter died on the evening's first attempt. The same morning, the officers had held an open reckoning about benching and roster fairness, and a five-point protest letter was circulating in private messages. Neither of the two players at the centre of the benching debate was in the kill.

2020-12-16/1006.title: The night Dusk became Ascension
2020-12-16/1006.html:
The night Dusk became Ascension

Decided almost casually in officer chat that afternoon and executed before the raid: everyone left Dusk and joined Ascension together. One officer wrote the era's epitaph in the channel — "its been good Sleep > Dusk > Ascension, we've done it all." The guild's most-attended tank quit the same evening, choosing to go "during the change."

2020-12-20/1006.title: 15 of 15
2020-12-20/1006.html:
15 of 15

Sapphiron at 19:53, Kel'Thuzad at 21:23 — Naxxramas cleared fourteen days after the first joint raid, and the goal the whole December upheaval had been aimed at. Within days, several members who had stayed for the clear left the game.
